ticket.title: Patient registration: Preserve local-language names when editing a patient
ticket.text:
Patient registration: Preserve local-language names when editing a patient

## Problem

Editing an existing patient deletes their local-language name even when the option remains enabled. This causes patient data loss.

## Affected code

- Name deletion during save
- getDeletedNames()

## Root cause

`getDeletedNames()` returns the existing additional-name UUID whenever one exists. It does not check whether `addNameInLocalLanguage` is still enabled, so the name is scheduled for deletion on every patient edit.

## How to reproduce

1. Open an existing patient who has a local-language name.
2. Edit an unrelated field.
3. Leave the local-language name option enabled.
4. Save the patient.
5. Wait for the deletion request to complete, then reload the patient.
6. The local-language name is missing.

## Expected behaviour

The local-language name should only be deleted when the user disables the option.

## Implementation notes

Use `values.addNameInLocalLanguage` when determining whether the existing additional name should be deleted. Coordinate this change with the deletion-awaiting fix so the corrected deletion request is awaited.

## Acceptance criteria

- Editing an unrelated field preserves the local-language name.
- Editing the local-language name updates it.
- Disabling the option removes the local-language name.
- Tests cover preserving, updating, and removing the name.

Verified against `openmrs-esm-patient-management` commit `c64fb3366119833e9e09a0eb31d580c9e1558d8b`.
